items.textToSpeech: Glucomannan contributes to the maintenance of normal blood cholesterol levels. The beneficial effect is obtained with a daily intake of 4 grams of glucomannan. The European Commission has authorised this claim for products which provide a daily intake of 4 grams of glucomannan.

Glucomannan contributes to weight loss, in the context of an energy restricted diet. The beneficial effect is obtained with a daily intake of 3 grams of glucomannan, in three doses of 1 gram each, together with 1-2 glasses of water, before meals and in the context of an energy-restricted diet. The European Commission has authorised this claim for products which provide 1 gram of glucomannan per quantified portion. To avoid choking, consume with plenty of water. Is there anything else I can help you with?
